passages.text: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.
passages.sermon: The prophet Zechariah looked up.\r\nHe saw a man.\r\nThe man held a measuring line in his hand.
passages.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֛י וָאֵ֖רֶא וְהִנֵּה־ אִ֑ישׁ וּבְיָד֖וֹ חֶ֥בֶל מִדָּֽה׃

passages.text: “Where are you going?” I asked. “To measure Jerusalem,” he replied, “and to determine its width and length.”
passages.sermon:
Zechariah saw a man.
The man held a measuring line in his hand.
Zechariah spoke to the man.
Zechariah asked, “Where are you going?”
The man answered Zechariah.
The man said, “I am going to measure Jerusalem.”
The man said, “I want to see how wide Jerusalem is.”
The man said, “I want to see how long Jerusalem is.”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אָ֖נָה אַתָּ֣ה הֹלֵ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י לָמֹד֙ אֶת־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִרְא֥וֹת כַּמָּֽה־ רָחְבָּ֖הּ וְכַמָּ֥ה אָרְכָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Then the angel who was speaking with me went out, and another angel came out to meet him and said to him, “Run and tell that young man: ‘Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the multitude of men and livestock within it.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke with me.
This angel went out.
Another angel came out to meet him.
The second angel spoke to the first angel.
He said, “Run and speak to that young man.”
He said, “Jerusalem will be a city without walls.”
Many people will live in Jerusalem.
Many animals will live in Jerusalem.
There will be so many people and animals that Jerusalem will not have walls.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י יֹצֵ֑א וּמַלְאָ֣ךְ אַחֵ֔ר יֹצֵ֖א לִקְרָאתֽוֹ׃ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔ו רֻ֗ץ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ הַנַּ֥עַר הַלָּ֖ז לֵאמֹ֑ר פְּרָזוֹת֙ תֵּשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מֵרֹ֥ב אָדָ֛ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃

passages.text: For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD promises to protect Jerusalem.
The LORD says, “I will be a wall of fire around Jerusalem.”
The LORD says, “I will be the glory inside Jerusalem.”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֤י אֶֽהְיֶה־ לָּהּ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה ח֥וֹמַת אֵ֖שׁ סָבִ֑יב וּלְכָב֖וֹד אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃פ

passages.text: “Get up! Get up! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the LORD, “for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD commands His people.
The LORD says, "Get up! Get up!"
The LORD says, "Flee from the land of the north."
The LORD says, "I have scattered you."
The LORD says, "I scattered you like the four winds of heaven."
passages.original: ה֣וֹי ה֗וֹי וְנֻ֛סוּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ צָפ֖וֹן נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֠י כְּאַרְבַּ֞ע רוּח֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם פֵּרַ֥שְׂתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Get up, O Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon!”
passages.sermon:
Zion, you are God's chosen people.
You live among the people of Babylon.
Get up now.
Escape from there.
Leave the Daughter of Babylon.
Save yourself.
passages.original: ה֥וֹי צִיּ֖וֹן הִמָּלְטִ֑י יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־ בָּבֶֽל׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “After His Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you—for whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye— I will surely wave My hand over them, so that they will become plunder for their own servants. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is the God of power and armies.
He says, “After My Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you, I will act.
These nations have taken from you.
Anyone who touches you touches the apple of My eye.
I will raise My hand against these nations.
They will become plunder for their own servants.
You will see this happen.
You will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me.”
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ אַחַ֣ר כָּב֔וֹד שְׁלָחַ֕נִי אֶל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם הַשֹּׁלְלִ֣ים אֶתְכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י הַנֹּגֵ֣עַ בָּכֶ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ בְּבָבַ֥ת עֵינֽוֹ׃ כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֨י מֵנִ֤יף אֶת־ יָדִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל לְעַבְדֵיהֶ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחָֽנִי׃ס

passages.text: “Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Zion.
The LORD commands Zion to rejoice.
The LORD says, “Shout for joy, Daughter of Zion.”
The LORD says, “Be glad.”
The LORD says, “I am coming.”
The LORD says, “I will dwell among you.”
passages.original: רָנִּ֥י וְשִׂמְחִ֖י בַּת־ צִיּ֑וֹן כִּ֧י הִנְנִי־ בָ֛א וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכֵ֖ךְ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD, and they will become My people. I will dwell among you, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God who commands heaven’s armies.
Many nations will join themselves to the LORD on that day.
These nations will become God’s people.
God will dwell among you.
You will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.
passages.original: וְנִלְווּ֩ גוֹיִ֨ם רַבִּ֤ים אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֣י בְתוֹכֵ֔ךְ וְיָדַ֕עַתְּ כִּי־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֵלָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His portion in the Holy Land, and He will once again choose Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will take Judah.
Judah will be the LORD’s portion.
The LORD will take Judah in the Holy Land.
The LORD will choose Jerusalem again.
passages.original: וְנָחַ֨ל יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ יְהוּדָה֙ חֶלְק֔וֹ עַ֖ל אַדְמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
He lives in His holy dwelling.
He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.
All people must be silent before the LORD.
passages.original: הַ֥ס כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֖ר מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י נֵע֖וֹר מִמְּע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ס
